component.name: DownloadPulse
component.summary: Download manager for links, files and video pages

description.p: DownloadPulse is a download manager for your computer. Web links, files on file servers and supported video pages all go into one queue, from the app or straight from your browser, and finished downloads land in the folder you choose.

ul.li: One queue for every download, whatever it comes from
Pause, resume and recover downloads, one at a time or all at once
Pair the DownloadPulse browser extension to send downloads from your browser, including ones that need your sign-in
With a system tray, close the window and your downloads keep going: the tray shows what is active
Notifications when downloads are added, finish, fail or are paused
Optional archive extraction, and a debrid or Usenet account when you have one
Your settings and history stay on your computer
